content: Ka rei dupaw cawh rycytu cawh zezongpui vytei a cy thlu ruapaw cang hmai seh la, nyheh a cang chung vytei cawh sae khatah a cangpaw beh.
A paw tei a reisipaw cai a tling hlai tai cawh a mingkaitu le a congtu kih rai lekhei a ungpaw a cang.
Ma hraco kaaning zong khazaw biahnuinah phung rai letei sae a za cangpaw nyheh hratah kaa za cang.
Canghrasala, a cai a zaw tih taco, Khazing tah Ama a Sawcapaw phungbia rai letei a ungpaw, canu tei sahpaw cawh,
phungbia rai letei a ungpaw kaaning sahlo cawh a sawtei leh kaa cang khy nápaw cawtah khei kaaning tlang pawtah a za thlaw.
A sawtei leh kaa cang cawtah Khazing tah a Sawcapaw a Thlawpaw cawh kaa lungthing chung letah za thlaw ka, ma Thlawpaw taco, “ Abba, Apaw,”
tatah a y.
Macawtaco sae cang khawh bei he ceh, sawtei leh cang myca he ceh ka, sawtei naa cangnah cawtah Khazing tah rycytu tah a ca tua my ca he.
Kalati khua cawngsaw cawtah Paul a thlaw a zawng
Khuahlai tei Khazing naa za hni ly ning takhei co, khazing hmuisui a cang lypaw aa sae khah na cang he ceh.

Canghrasala, atoheh cawh Khazing naa hni, a cang ly leh Khazing tei a hnipaw na cang hri he ceh. Zecawtamaw a chahnai khawh lypaw le a padia a padapaw khazaw biahnuinah phung lang na paleh kaw zia he ceh? Ma sahlo sae letei ung kaw camaw naa du?
Ning puimawpaw, thlaw puimawpaw le khuacai puimawpaw le kung puimawpaw sahlo cawh naa panaw tei!
Naa cawtah raisah ka hrepaw khah a longpaw tah naa tua sua a, tah ka phang caimang.
Uny sahlo, kama hrahei cang my lo, tatah ka ca naw he. Zemaw tah pawco, kama zong naaning hratah ka cang hrah. Ka cung letah hmingsua zehmai tua bei ceh.
Naa hni thlangpaw hratah naaning khatah thawngchawbia ka va rei hmasaw taw ning takhei ka dang lypaw rawng tah a cang.

Ka dang lypaw khah naaning hnehsahnah tah a cang hmai takhei zetah parei lytah ung beca he ceh ka pa nytaw bei he ceh. Khazing a vaiming hratah le Khri Zisu hratah achaw teitah naa pa cyhlang laky thlang kho.
Ma ning takhei na lawng ngetei he ceh kho, ma vytei khah zelang maw a ung thlu? Cang khy seh la naa mehlung hmai khy hly he ceh ka, naa pa peh thlang a, tah cawh ka rei ngang.
Biahmuisui ka ca chingnah rawng he tah atoheh naa carae ka cang sua myca maw?

A pa dytu sahlo tei chahnai aa ngepaw cawh naaning te pahnei rua pawtah a cang, canghrasala naa caw taco a chahnah ung be. Aa dupaw cawh naaning khah kaaning taitah pachai khah cang ka, ma pawsui co, aaning aa cawtah chahnai naa nge khy nápaw khah a cang.
Tingainah achawpaw tua rua pawtei chahnai nge cawh a chah thlang, naaning zong kama ka ungning long tah cang lytah naa tua teipaw le naa tua paria teipaw a cang.
Ka dopaw sawtei sahlo, naa cawtah canu ny ung risaw aa taipaw hratah ka tai kaw hui. Naa chung letah Khri cangnah khah a ung hlai vytei cawh ka tai cong thlang hi.
Ato lehei co, naaning khatah ung tah ka orei zong pananing ka du caimang, zemaw tatah naa kong lehei ka lung hna a hnawh ngetei myca!
Haga le Sarah
Naaning phungbia rai letei ung a dupaw sahlo, ma heh pa ching tua o. Phungbia tah zemaw a rei takhah hnih bei he ceh maw?
Ma heh ciapaw cawh a cang. Abraham tah sawcapaw pahning a hnui, pakhehpaw cawh saecanu Haga khatah a sahpaw cang ka, pakhehpaw cawh meh zalong Sara khatah a sahpaw a cang.
Saecanu khatei a sahpaw a sawcapaw cawh cawngsaw phung tah a pipaw a cang; canghrasala mehzalong khatei a sahpaw a sawcapaw cawh biakangpaw hratah a pipaw a cang.

Ma hming sahlo heh tawchingnah tah lah khy a cang he. Zemaw tah pawco, ma canu pahning heh biahrai sanghning tawchingnah a cang he. Biahrai sangkheh cawh Sinai tlaang letah peh a cang. Ma biahrai cawh saecanu a cangpaw Haga khakhei tawching cang ka, sae a cangpaw sawtei sahlo khah a sah he.

Haga cawh Arabia raang letei a ungpaw Sinai tlaang caipaw khah a cang. Atochai letei Jerusalem khuapui takhei a cang, zecawtamaw tatah Jerusalem le a cawngsaw sahlo cawh sae hratah phungbia rai letah a ung he.
Canghrasala vaicung Jerusalem cawh a zalongpaw cang ka, ama cawh kaaning kaa no a cang.
Ma heh ciapaw cawh a cang,

content.text: “Vy a cingpaw canu, sawtei a sah khy lypaw a lawng tua,
nama ny ung risaw a ing bang lypaw lunglawngná khei y tua,
zecawtamaw tatah ama long teitah a cangpaw canu cawh
a pasae khatah a ungpaw canu navy khei sawtei hlu vy a hnui a,”

content: tatah a tah.
Atoheh cawh naaning uny sahlo cawh Sara tei a sahpaw Isak hratah biakangpaw sawtei naa cang he ceh.
Ma ningcai taco cawngsaw phung tei a pipaw sawcapaw takhei Thlawpaw hmingtuakhyná tah a pipaw sawcapaw khah a hreh. Ma cawh ato khahei a lo.

Canghrasala, Capathai tah zemaw a rei? “Saecanu le a sawcapaw khah papia o, zecawtamaw tatah saecanu a sawcapaw taco a zalongno a sawcapaw khatah hmingkheh tah a paw a ry cawh a hrawng khy be,” a tah.
Macawtaco uny sahlo, kaaning sahlo cawh saecanu a sawtei leh cang ly patah a zalongno a sawtei leh ka cang hri he peh hi.

footnotes.text: Abba tah cawh Aramaik rei cang ka, Apaw,tahnah a cang.
